name: Tahona
menu_notes: Source used: tahonabar.com's live menu PDF (linked from the homepage, same document family as our source_url). All 10 checked dishes across Tostadas, Appetizers, Tacos, Sopas/Fuertes, and Desserts matched exactly on name and price: Ahi Tostada $18, Double Machaca Wagyu Tostada $19, Chips & Salsa $4, Signature Guacamole $14, Mole & Sourdough Flight $14, Empanadas de Picadillo (3) $18, Esquite Salad $18, Corn Croquetas (6) $12, Ceviche Loco $21, Asada Norteño Taco $7 all confirmed, plus Kurobuta Pork Shank Pozole, Short Rib Birria Ramen, Mexican Churros and Mousse de Chocolate also matched.
data_notes: Address (2414 San Diego Ave, San Diego, CA 92110) and lat/lng (32.7518, -117.1933) are correct for Old Town. Neighborhood label 'Old Town' is correct. Hours match the live listing exactly for all 7 days (Mon 5-9pm, Tue-Thu 5-10pm, Fri 5-11pm, Sat 4-11pm, Sun 4-10pm). Restaurant confirmed open. Cuisine is labeled 'Bars'/'Cocktail Bars', but Tahona is really a full modern-Mexican restaurant (extensive food menu) with a notable mezcal bar attached, so the cuisine label undersells/mischaracterizes the food offering.
